implementation_constraints.evidence: OpenRaft storage/v2.rs43-48,74-79,108-129,162-201,226-255 require serialized vote/log IO, readable append at return, persistence before successful callback, and last-applied/membership snapshot state. raw_node.rs197-225,645-710 separates persisted messages, advance, advance_append and advance_apply; advance already calls advance_apply_to. implementation_constraints.counterexample: A Ready contains committed entry1; the adapter persists it and calls advance before actual application. The library applied index becomes1 while the application is still0. Checking only library progress could falsely accept this. Similarly a callback-success marker before file sync is not persistence.
implementation_constraints.alternative: Either apply/persist Ready committed entries before advance, or use advance_append after persistence then apply Ready+LightReady committed entries in order and advance_apply_to the actual applied index. Persist a recoverable consistent state/applied-ID/membership tuple (or a valid snapshot+replay cut); use independent trace/file evidence and separate corruption/error controls.
